newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Tryg-Baltica appoints new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Danish Tryg-Baltica appoints new CEO.

text.p: Denmark's biggest insurance company Tryg-Baltica Forsikring said on Thursday it appointed Hugo Andersen as new group managing director, president and chief executive.
Andersen, 49, is to succeed Alf Duch-Pedersen, who is to leave on March 31, 1997, the company said in a statement.

It said Andersen, who has been group managing director and deputy group chief executive of Denmark's biggest mortgage credit group Nykredit since 1990, would join Tryg-Baltica as soon as he has completed his present duties at the latest on July 1,1997. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
